register.labelZh: FIRE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: fire away 讓你可以用友善而直接的方式,請對方開始提問或解釋自己的構思。；fire somebody up 可以描述一段講話、一首歌曲、教練或群眾如何令他人振奮起來,準備行動。；fire something off 可以描述迅速發射信號彈、煙花、火箭或槍炮的情況。；fire something up 適合用來談論啟動燒烤爐、暖爐、發電機、焗爐和其他機器。
register.summaryEn: Fire away gives you a friendly and confident way to tell someone that they may begin asking questions or explaining an idea. Fire somebody up helps you describe how a speech, song, coach or crowd makes people excited and ready to act. Fire something off allows you to describe the quick launching of flares, fireworks, rockets or shots. Fire something up is useful when starting grills, heaters, generators, ovens and other machines.

fixedVariable.variableZh: Fire away 本身已是完整表達。你可以按需要加上 with your questions 等資料,但這些字並不是核心表達的一部分。；使用 him、her、it 或 them 時,請按照以上例子把代名詞放在 FIRE 和 UP/OFF 之間。；請仔細閱讀情境:fire somebody up 表示令某人或一群人振奮起來;fire something up 表示啟動機器、暖爐、焗爐或燒烤爐。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Fire away is complete by itself. Extra words such as with your questions may be added when useful, but they are not part of the core expression. When using him, her, it or them, place the word as shown: fire them up fire it off fire it up Read the context carefully: fire somebody up = make a person or group excited and ready fire something up = start a machine, heater, oven or grill
